profile.description: Stringprep profile to use. Valid values: Nameprep, iSCSI, Nodeprep, Resourceprep, trace, SASLprep.

normalize_nfkc.description: Normalize string according to Unicode v3.2 NFKC (--nfkc).

no_tld.description: Don't check string for TLD specific rules (--no-tld).

stringprep.description: Prepare string according to nameprep profile (--stringprep).

idna_to_ascii.description: Convert to ACE according to IDNA (--idna-to-ascii).

idna_to_unicode.description: Convert from ACE according to IDNA (--idna-to-unicode).

strings.description: List of domain strings to process. If empty, input is read from stdin.
